exposure: Women with previous ASI who had spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD)
Women with previous ASI who had cesarean section
Women with previous ASI who had instrumental delivery
cohort: Women with a history of ASI who delivered between 2010 and 2012 (n=138)
finding: While the majority of women with a history of ASI did not experience a recurrent ASI following vaginal delivery, there is still a 13.4% risk of recurrence, highlighting the importance of individualized antenatal assessment and counseling.
mod_finding: The study found that 50% of women with a previous anal sphincter injury had a spontaneous vaginal delivery in their subsequent pregnancy.
birth_weight: Average birthweight reported for subgroups with and without recurrent ASI (3644g vs. 3680g)
